description: Perfect for up to 20 guests at The Beach Pad, a 7-bedroom villa steps from Sandy Beach in the heart of Rincon! 4 Studio lofts + 3BR Surf House Rooftop deck, ocean viewsPrivate yard & BBQFull kitchens/kitchenettesBeach gear & yoga matsUninterrupted power & waterWasher & DryerIdeal for reunions, retreats, or getaways. At night you can wish on a shooting star, or dance under the romantic string lights. If it's a lazy day after the beach, take siesta in the hammock.

description: Step outside and you're on the beach! Thirty seconds from the front door to salt water, every morning of your stay. Your front yard has world-class surf, a tidal pool the family will claim immediately, and a raw stretch of beach for walking. This is a four-bedroom beachfront villa on one of Rincón's most desirable stretches of coast. Gated, private, and almost always uncrowded. You can hear the ocean from every room. A rooftop terrace with sunset views is waiting upstairs.The spaceThe rooftop terrace is a real part of the stay, not a checkbox. Morning coffee, sunset cocktails, stargazing, yoga, or lying in the Bali bed listening to the surf below. More than a few guests have slept up there under the stars. It gets used differently by every group and mentioned by nearly every one of them.The primary suite has a king bed and ensuite bathroom. The second bedroom has a queen. The third has two twins that convert to a king, great for kids or a third couple. The fourth works well as a flex room or extra sleeping space. Two full bathrooms plus a half bath and an outdoor shower to wash away the sand. Surfboards, boogie boards, beach chairs, umbrellas, a cooler, and beach towels are all stocked. Past guests consistently call this one of their favorite parts. It saves money on rentals and means you hit the water in minutes, not hours. The kitchen is stocked for people who actually cook: Vitamix, espresso machine, and the basics you'd want if you were staying a week. Inside, Starlink Wi-Fi and a dedicated workspace with one of the better views in the house make this a real option for remote work. Guests have used it for month-long stays without a reliability issue. For anyone familiar with Puerto Rico's grid: the backup generator and whole-house water filtration system have handled multi-day outages without disruption.Walk the beach to Casa Isleña for brunch, one of the better morning routines in Rincón. Crash Boat and Jobos are easy day trips. Rincón Plaza, the main restaurant corridor, and central town are a short drive. Guests with very young children or beginner swimmers should plan on calmer nearby beaches on high-swell days.The host's local recommendations come up in reviews as often as the house itself: where locals eat, where to find the best brunch, how to arrange massage therapists or a yoga session on the rooftop. The community is gated with security. Self check-in, pre-arrival instructions, and a digital house guide make arrival seamless.Guest accessEach villas has 2 parking spots. Guests have access to commUNITY pool, tennis courts, basketball courts and gym. Tennis and pickeball courts can reserve ahead of time with HOA office.Other things to noteWater filtration system through the house. Fully equipped kitchen for foodies. From vitamix and espresso machine to a great assortment of pots and baking pans. Cooking basics: Himalayan salt, black pepper crushed and peppercorns, organic olive oil and balsamic vinegar, spices, brown sugar, honey and coconut oil.Villa is equipped with back up generator and WIFI provider is on solar energy.We get delivered organic produce weekly from local farmers. If you would be interested let us know ahead of time as they send their weekly harvest at the beginning of each week and deliver mid week. We will gladly receive for you if before check in.In need of a wellness retreat? We’ll create it for you. From yoga classes and massages to private chef & detox programs. Concierge services .

description: Enjoy island living at its best at Casa de Playa located in Rincón's best kept secret, Punta del Mar Beach Village, an oceanfront gated community in the north shore of Rincón, the town of beautiful sunsets.. And miles of secluded coastline...just paradise!The spaceThe 1800 sq ft solar powered villa is equipped with everything you need to feel right at home. First level: living room with 65 inch smart TV with DirecTV cable, dining room, fully equipped kitchen, bedroom for 2, powder room and outdoor patio with BBQ and seating area.Second level: master bedroom with en suite bathroom, guest room that sleeps up to three (convertible to a king size if traveling with other couples), another full bathroom, laundry room and outdoor terrace perfect for chilling stargazing.AC units throughout the house an double internet provider for backup.Each villas has 2 parking spots.
